name: privatools_list_tools
description: Search and filter PrivaTools file processing operations by keyword, category, or execution mode (sync/async). Progressive discovery step 1 before calling privatools_describe_tool. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Optional keyword search across operation slugs, aliases, summaries, and categories (e.g. 'compress', 'merge', 'ocr', 'watermark').

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Optional case-insensitive category filter (e.g. 'PDF processing', 'Image', 'Audio and video', 'Accessibility').

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Execution mode filter: 'all' (default), 'sync', or 'async'.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of operations to return (1-250, default 50).

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Pagination offset (default 0).

name: privatools_describe_tool
description: Inspect the exact HTTP method, upload fields, form/query parameters, constraints, cost, async support, input limits, and response media types for a PrivaTools operation slug or alias. Progressive discovery step 2 before calling privatools_run_tool. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Operation slug, path, or alias (e.g. 'compress', 'compress-pdf', 'merge', 'pdf-to-text', 'accessibility-check').

name: privatools_run_tool
description: Execute any synchronous PrivaTools operation (PDF, image, office, audio/video, QR, OCR, accessibility, etc.). Supply file inputs via public https:// URLs (up to 500 MiB matching the website MAX_UPLOAD_MB; max 2 concurrent fetches per IP, 30s idle timeout, 180s total deadline) or inline base64 (up to 25 MiB decoded — JSON-RPC payload limit). JSON-returning operations return data inline; binary outputs (up to 500 MiB) return a short-lived download URL (15-minute TTL) and a resource_link block. Works anonymously without an account; optional X-API-Key header uses /api/v1 quota. Call privatools_describe_tool first for parameter details. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Operation slug, path, or alias (e.g. 'compress', 'merge', 'rotate', 'pdf-to-text', 'accessibility-check').

arguments.name: file_url
arguments.desc: Single input file as a public https:// URL (SSRF-protected; up to 500 MiB, matching the website upload cap).

arguments.name: file_urls
arguments.desc: Multiple input files as public https:// URLs, in order (up to 500 MiB each).

arguments.name: file_base64
arguments.desc: Single input file encoded as inline base64 (max 25 MiB decoded JSON-RPC cap; use file_url for larger files up to 500 MiB).

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: Optional filename with extension for file_base64 or file_url (e.g. 'report.pdf').

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: Multiple input files (url or base64) with optional per-file filename and multipart field name.

arguments.name: file_field
arguments.desc: Optional multipart upload field name override (auto-detected from schema when omitted).

arguments.name: params
arguments.desc: Optional operation parameters (form fields, JSON body fields, or query params).

name: privatools_submit_job
description: Submit an asynchronous background job (POST /api/v1/jobs) for supported heavy operations ('merge', 'compress', 'grayscale', 'pdf-to-text'). Requires an X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer header. Accepts https:// URLs or base64 PDF inputs. Poll progress with privatools_job_status and clean up with privatools_delete_job. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Async operation slug (e.g. 'merge', 'compress', 'grayscale', 'pdf-to-text').

arguments.name: file_url
arguments.desc: Single PDF input file as a public https:// URL.

arguments.name: file_urls
arguments.desc: Multiple PDF input files as public https:// URLs, in order.

arguments.name: file_base64
arguments.desc: Single PDF input file encoded as base64 (max 25 MiB decoded).

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: Optional PDF filename (e.g. 'input.pdf').

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: Multiple PDF input files (url or base64) in order.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Optional operation-specific options object (e.g. {'level': 'recommended'} for compress).

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Optional Idempotency-Key (1-128 visible ASCII chars) for safe retries. Auto-generated when omitted.

name: privatools_job_status
description: Read-only: poll an asynchronous job's status (GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}) and optionally retrieve a short-lived download link or JSON result once succeeded (include_result: true). Requires the submitting X-API-Key. Never deletes or cancels the job; use privatools_delete_job for deletion. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by privatools_submit_job.

arguments.name: include_result
arguments.desc: When true and the job has succeeded, also return a short-lived download_url + resource_link (or inline JSON for pdf-to-text).

name: privatools_delete_job
description: Permanently delete a completed async job's server-side artifacts or cancel a queued/running job (DELETE /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}). Requires the submitting X-API-Key. Repeated deletion is idempotent. Full OpenAPI documentation: https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by privatools_submit_job.
